# OpenClaw for Open WebUI

> Chat with your OpenClaw agents from Open WebUI and watch them work: tool calls as cards, questions as dialogs, sub-agents in a live panel. It connects to a running OpenClaw Gateway with three Open WebUI functions: a Pipe (the chat), a Status Action (context, rate limits, sub-agents) and a thinking filter. Every page below is plain Markdown in this repo; start at docs/index.md.

## Start

- [README](README.md): what it is, the install in three steps, where everything else is
- [Docs index](docs/index.md): every page with a one-line description

## Install

- [Quick start](docs/install/quickstart.md): from nothing to the first reply, with a check at each step
- [Installer](docs/install/installer.md): install.py, its wizard, flags, environment variables and commands
- [Manual install](docs/install/manual.md): paste the function in the admin panel and set its valves
- [Device pairing](docs/install/pairing.md): approving the device, where its identity lives
- [Status Action](docs/install/status-action.md): the Status button and its rate-limit plugin
- [Thinking filter](docs/install/thinking-filter.md): the per-chat thinking control
- [Agent skills](docs/install/agent-skills.md): teaching the agent the questions and media conventions
- [Update and uninstall](docs/install/update-uninstall.md)
- [Two hosts](docs/install/two-hosts.md): Open WebUI and OpenClaw on different machines

## Use

- [Features](docs/features/index.md): the full list, each linked to its page
- [Configuration](docs/configuration.md): every valve of the three functions, generated from the code

- [Troubleshooting](docs/troubleshooting.md): symptoms, logs, what to put in a bug report
